caseName: First Marblehead Corp. v. Mass. Comm'r Revenue
caseNameFull: THE FIRST MARBLEHEAD CORPORATION v. MASSACHUSETTS COMMISSIONER OF REVENUE.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Judicial Court of Massachusetts. Petition for writ of certiorari granted. Judgment vacated, and case remanded to the Supreme Judicial Court of Massachusetts for further consideration in the light of Comptroller of Treasury of Md. v.
